outcome: specific human milk metabolites (e.g., DHA, hexoses, amino acids, sphingolipids, glycosyl-ceramides, triglycerides)
cohort: The study included 123 healthy lactating women.
finding: The human milk metabolome was grouped into three distinct clusters, primarily driven by triglyceride concentration differences, and was influenced by delivery mode, lactation practices, and maternal diet.
mod_finding: Docosahexaenoic acid (DHA) levels were higher in human milk from mothers with vaginal delivery compared to C-section births.
